CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_cross_checks (
	application_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	statement_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	credits_paise JSON NOT NULL, 
	months JSON NOT NULL, 
	signals JSON NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	consent_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (application_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_bank_cross_checks_customer_id ON bank_cross_checks (customer_id)
